name: Gizi Izalogo
source:
Heir to the prestigious Izalogo Family of GraveKeepers, Gizi was born with a silver spoon in her mouth and a tiny golden scepter in her hand.

However, her position is more fragile than she lets on and her attitude, unchecked, may lead her to disaster.

First appearance: GraveKeeper Academy
